title: Karbo Bala Se Jaraha (Karuwan Sajjad Ka)
body:
Karbo Bala se jaraha hai karuwan Sajjad ka,
Har abele se paun k qoon hai rawan Sajjad
Karbobala se...2
1) jalti Zamin paidal safar bimaari aur tauqe ghiran-2
Halqa kiye chalti rahi saidaniyan Sajjad ka.
Karbobala se...2
2) purr qwaar raahe nange paa jane safar kaise kataa-2
Nouha sunaati rehgayee qud bediyan Sajjad ka.
Karbobala se....2
3) jab bibiyun ko bay ridaa bazaar me laye aduu-2
Shar mindagii se patt gayaa dil natawan Sajjad kaa.
Karbobala se....2
4) ihle jafa ne isghadarr durre lagaye poshth par-2
Afsooz hai Sara badan qoon me nihaan Sajjad ka.
Karbobala se...2
5) galliyun me sheh re shaam kay anghanrin jabb phey k gaye-2
Jalne lagaa ya Fathimaa sarr natawan Sajjad ka.
Karbobala se....2
6) kya Ho MUJEEB ham se bayan halate qaaide shaam k,
Kaise MUQARRIB se bhala ghamm ho bayan Sajjad ka.
Karbobala se jaraha hai karuwan Sajjad kaaaaa....3
